candidates.snippet: This comes on the first full day of Reform's annual party conference in Birmingham

Party leader Nigel Farage's senior aide Dan Jukes and Reform's head of policy James Orr, an associate professor at the University of Cambridge, stepped down from their roles on Friday morning pending the outcome of an internal party investigation

Reform UK has suspended two senior party figures after they were filmed appearing to try and skirt electoral law to secure a foreign donation of £500,000 ($680,000) for the party https://t.co/DEZkzM2Dc6 https://t.co/t8Jl5hUCHr
